desks.headline: Whose preference is this?
desks.summary: Look at one shared plan: the restaurant, meeting time or activity. Did somebody actually choose it, or did everyone inherit the first suggestion? Ask the people involved what matters to them before changing anything. You may keep the plan; at least this time you will know why.
